posts.text:
Web3 Fundamentals (15 lessons): Wallets and Private Keys.

Self-custody: you control keys or permissions. A custodian manages them for you. A signature proves account control, not legal identity.
posts.alt: Wallets and Private Keys, lesson 5 of 15 in Web3 Fundamentals. The excerpt contrasts self-custody, where you control keys or account permissions, with custodial services managing them for you. Wallets sign messages and transactions; signatures establish account control, not legal identity.

posts.text:
Decentralized Finance (9 lessons): Lending and Borrowing in DeFi.

Example: 80% LTV on $1,000 collateral gives an $800 borrowing cap. Liquidation uses a separate threshold, with parameters set per market.
posts.alt: Lending and Borrowing in DeFi, lesson 2 of 9. Example: $1,000 collateral at 80% loan-to-value gives an $800 borrowing cap. The lesson excerpt explains that allowed LTV depends on the asset, market and risk parameters. Liquidation uses a separate threshold.

posts.text:
Smart Contract Development (9 lessons): Testing Smart Contracts.

The sample transfers 100 units from a 1,000-unit balance and asserts 100 received, 900 left. Foundry fuzz tests vary the amount to test properties.
posts.alt: Testing Smart Contracts, lesson 5 of 9, with a Foundry test_Transfer code excerpt. The sample transfers 100 raw units from a 1,000-unit balance and asserts 100 received and 900 remaining. Fuzz tests vary the transfer amount to test properties.

posts.text:
Web3 Marketing & Community (8 lessons): Growth Metrics and Analytics.

Unique Active Wallets counts addresses over a defined period; one person can control several. Retention measures return activity from a starting cohort.
posts.alt: Growth Metrics and Analytics, lesson 5 of 8 in Web3 Marketing & Community. The excerpt distinguishes accounts, addresses, transactions, sessions and people. Unique Active Wallets counts addresses over a defined period; one person can control several. Retention measures return activity from a starting cohort.

posts.text:
AI x Crypto Intersection (7 lessons): Autonomous Agents.

Separate model, tools and wallet. Balance reads should not grant transfer-signing permission. Enforce spending caps and contract allowlists.

hashtagweb3.com/learn/x
posts.alt: Autonomous Agents, lesson 2 of 7 in AI x Crypto Intersection. The excerpt separates permission to read a balance, draft a transaction and sign a transfer. Keep model decisions, tools and wallet signing separate; enforce spending caps and contract allowlists.
